title: account — Multi-Company Intercompany Journal + Shared COA

key_findings.account_inter_company_rules_presence: ABSENT — module directory not found in Community addons; automated intercompany invoice/bill creation is Enterprise-only
key_findings.shared_coa_mechanism: account.account uses company_ids Many2many (account_account.py:97); accounts can be shared across companies, but Bank/Cash accounts are blocked from sharing (account_account.py:280-281)
key_findings.subsidiary_coa_inheritance: Subsidiaries inherit parent account records rather than receiving copies; chart_template.py:228-231 limits subsidiary load to res.company data only; chart_template.py:908-910 assigns parent account pointers
key_findings.journal_company_enforcement: Journals are strictly per-company (account_journal.py:172); _check_company_auto=True on account.move (account_move.py:79) validates all check_company fields automatically
key_findings.balance_check_per_company: _check_balanced SQL joins to company currency for decimal precision (account_move.py:2810-2821) — no cross-company aggregation
key_findings.intercompany_automation_absent: Full scan of account/models/ finds no _create_intercompany, auto_invoice, auto_bill or mirror-document creation methods — manual entry only
key_findings.gap_002_verdict: OPEN — no automated intercompany journal mechanism in Community
key_findings.gap_018_verdict: PARTIAL — account sharing via company_ids Many2many and subsidiary inheritance is present, but lacks Enterprise governance layer
